title: Berlin Zoo Annual Pass - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Four annual cards exist:** Zoo €69, Tierpark €69, Zoo + Aquarium €102.50 and all three €119 for one adult. Children aged 4 to 15 pay €37 to €63, under 4 is free.
**A Zoo card gets you half the regular day price at the Tierpark and the Aquarium,** and the Tierpark card does the same the other way round.
**Family cards cover one or both parents plus their own children,** from €88.50 for the Zoo. Everyone needs the same address, proof for each child, and must be there when the card is issued.
**Against the €25 gate price a card pays off by the third adult visit;** against online tickets from €16 it needs about five.
**From 26 October to 22 February the Zoo and Tierpark close at 16:30,** last entry 15:30. The Aquarium stays open 9:00 to 18:00 all year.
**The subscription saves about 10 percent but runs at least 24 months.** Take it in the second year, once you know how often you go.
**New Zoo and Aquarium cards from 2 November 2026:** swap free by 30 June 2027, get a free day ticket if you swap by 15 February 2027. Face recognition at the turnstiles is optional.
